items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Used to play with Kelton for, oh, he played in a blue room with Kelton for years.

ctx.x: Yeah, I've seen him. He plays, he works for this Orkin people.

They spray, they spray our house. And he says, ah, what, you don't play no more. I said, no, boy. I said, man, you oughta get what I do. I was playing the Tin Roof Blues when he walked in. He said, you're letting all this talent go to waste. Is he that sort of tall, skinny guy? Nice guy. Yeah. Used to play with Kelton for, oh, he played in a blue room with Kelton for years. He's a nice guy. I heard him. I heard him.
Okay, reel three, Albert Artigue, December the 15th, 1961. What about the Fort Myers? Did you ever hear them?
